Setting up: the gate opens at 7:00. Stalls must be ready by 8:30. Vehicles leave the market square by 8:15.
Trestle tables and a gazebo are in the blue shed by the toilets. Weights for the gazebo legs are in the shed too.
Packing down: not before 14:00. Take all rubbish with you. Leftover jars go back in the crates in the van.
Pitch 14 is next to the first-aid point. Ask Joan at the market office if anything goes wrong.
